changed: With Free-text entry on, the Done button under the Type a figure box is now Finish adding. It adds a line still in the box before closing it, instead of throwing the line away.
fixed: Saving a dance with a line still in the Type a figure box adds that figure first, as pressing Enter would. Leaving the editor with a line in the box asks before discarding it.
The beat Total no longer counts a meanwhile or modifier group that is not complete enough to be saved.
A figure row with no move but a note is saved as a custom figure holding the note, instead of being dropped with its note.
Undo pressed straight after typing undoes the typing, instead of losing it and undoing the change before it.
